# xchtip.app

> xchtip.app is a free builder for an embeddable Chia tip button. A creator picks a recipient
> Chia address, an asset (XCH or any CAT, including $DIG), and a color scheme, then copies a
> one-line `<script>` snippet onto any website. Visitors connect a Chia wallet (WalletConnect →
> Sage) and send a tip on-chain, wallet to wallet — no account, no middleman, nothing custodial.

## What you can do here

- Build a tip-button embed snippet from a recipient + asset + color, via the UI or the URL API.
- Get the RAW embed snippet as plain text (no UI) so a tool/agent can generate embed codes.
- Share a standalone tip page for a recipient at `https://xchtip.app/jar/<recipient>?...` — a full,
  ready-to-share landing page with a working tip button, no site or embedding needed.

## URL query-param API

The builder page (`https://xchtip.app/`) accepts query parameters. With no `raw` flag they PRE-FILL
the builder UI. With `raw=1` (or `format=raw`) the page returns ONLY the machine-readable embed
snippet as plain text — nothing else to scrape.

Parameters:

- `recipient` (required) — the recipient's Chia bech32m address, e.g. `xch1...` (mainnet). Validated:
  a correct bech32m checksum, an `xch`/`txch` HRP, and a 32-byte puzzle hash.
- `asset` (required) — `xch` for native XCH, OR a 64-character hex CAT asset id for a CAT tip
  (case-insensitive, an optional `0x` prefix is stripped). Presets: `$DIG`
  (`a406d3a9de984d03c9591c10d917593b434d5263cabe2b42f6b367df16832f81`) and `HOA`
  (`e816ee18ce2337c4128449bc539fbbe2ecfdd2098c4e7cab4667e223c3bdc23d`).
- `scheme` (optional) — `green` (default; the XCH scheme), `purple` (the $DIG brand scheme), or
  `orange` (the HOA brand scheme). A 6-hex color value here is also accepted and treated as a custom accent.
- `color` (optional) — a custom 6-hex accent color, e.g. `#7a3dff`. Overrides `scheme` (sets custom).
- `presets` (optional) — comma-separated preset amounts in whole units of the asset, e.g. `1,5,25`.
- `label` (optional) — a custom button label.
- `variant` (optional) — the widget style: `button` (default), `compact`, `pill`, `inline`, `banner`, or `card`.
- `symbol` (optional) — a CAT display symbol override (e.g. `DIG`); auto-detected otherwise.
- `name` (optional) — a recipient display name (e.g. a handle or store label). Shown on the tip page
  above the address and on the `card`/`banner` widget variants; sanitized and capped at 64 characters.
- `logo` (optional) — a custom logo/mark URL shown instead of the built-in DIG/HOA/XCH mark, wherever
  the asset is named (the button's leading glyph, the tip page's "Paid in `<asset>`" line). MUST be
  an `https://` URL or a `data:image/{png,jpg,jpeg,gif,webp,svg+xml};base64,` URL; any other scheme
  is dropped (falls back to the built-in mark). A load failure also falls back to the built-in mark.
- `raw` (optional) — `1`/`true` → return the snippet as plain text only (raw mode).
- `format` (optional) — `raw` is equivalent to `raw=1`.

The canonical `$DIG` CAT asset id is
`a406d3a9de984d03c9591c10d917593b434d5263cabe2b42f6b367df16832f81` (Chia mainnet).

### Examples

- Pre-fill the builder for an XCH tip:
  `https://xchtip.app/?recipient=xch1...&asset=xch&scheme=green`
- Raw snippet for a $DIG tip (plain text):
  `https://xchtip.app/?recipient=xch1...&asset=a406d3a9de984d03c9591c10d917593b434d5263cabe2b42f6b367df16832f81&scheme=purple&raw=1`
- Raw snippet for a custom-color XCH tip:
  `https://xchtip.app/?recipient=xch1...&asset=xch&color=%2300aabb&presets=1,5&raw=1`

### Raw plain-text endpoint

`https://xchtip.app/embed.txt?<same params>` returns the snippet with `Content-Type: text/plain`
(served at the edge). The SPA raw mode (`?...&raw=1`) renders the identical snippet inside a single
`<pre data-testid="raw-snippet">` element for clients that execute JavaScript.

## Tip-jar pages (a standalone hosted tip page per recipient)

`https://xchtip.app/jar/<recipient>` is a full, shareable tip page for one recipient — no embedding
and no backend: EVERY setting rides in the URL, so the same recipient (+ asset + scheme) always maps
to the same page. The recipient hands out this link; a tipper opens it and sends on-chain via the
same widget.

The path segment is the recipient bech32m address. Optional query params (a canonical, fixed order;
defaults omitted): `asset=<64-hex CAT id>` (omit for XCH), `scheme=purple`, `color=%23rrggbb`,
`presets=1,5,25`, `label=<text>`, `name=<display name>`, `logo=<url>`. Each jar URL is its own SEO
page (unique title, description, canonical, Open Graph) so a shared link previews well.

The page THEMES to the selected scheme end-to-end (not a fixed color): a `$DIG` jar reads purple,
an `HOA` jar orange, XCH green, a custom `color` tints the same surfaces. It also shows that asset's
logo/glyph (or a custom `logo=` mark) next to the asset name.

Example: `https://xchtip.app/jar/xch1...?asset=a406d3a9de984d03c9591c10d917593b434d5263cabe2b42f6b367df16832f81&scheme=purple&name=Alice`

## Embed preview (for integrators embedding a live preview)

`https://xchtip.app/embed-preview?recipient=<xch1...>&asset=<xch|catId>&scheme=<green|purple|orange|hex>&name=<text>&logo=<url>`
is a minimal, CHROMELESS route — no header/footer/hero — rendering ONLY the live embed widget for the
given params, on a transparent background. Built to be `<iframe>`d by a third-party page (e.g.
hub.dig.net's Developer-tab "Embeddable Tip button" panel) for a real, isolated live preview; the
route is frameable by design (no `X-Frame-Options`/`frame-ancestors`, matching the rest of the site).
An invalid/incomplete `recipient` renders a blank, transparent stage (no error) so a mid-edit state
looks clean while the embedding page's form is incomplete.

## The embed snippet (data-attribute contract)

The generated snippet is a single self-contained script tag served from `https://xchtip.app/embed/xch-tip.js`:

```
<script src="https://xchtip.app/embed/xch-tip.js"
        data-recipient="xch1..."
        data-asset="xch"                 (or a 64-hex CAT asset id)
        data-scheme="green"              (green | purple | orange)
        data-color="#7a3dff"             (optional custom accent; overrides data-scheme)
        data-amount-presets="1,5,25"     (optional)
        data-label="Tip"                 (optional)
        data-size="md"                   (optional: md | lg — lg = a prominent tip-page button)
        data-variant="button"            (optional: button|compact|pill|inline|banner|card)
        data-symbol="DIG"                (optional: CAT display symbol; auto-detected otherwise)
        data-name="Alice"                (optional: recipient display name; card/banner + jar page)
        data-logo="https://…/logo.png"   (optional: custom logo; overrides the built-in DIG/HOA/XCH mark)
        async></script>
```

The widget is fully self-contained: on click it opens its own WalletConnect session, lets the visitor
pick an amount, builds the spend client-side (XCH = a plain standard spend; a CAT = a CAT spend for
that asset id), signs via the wallet, and broadcasts to Chia mainnet. A 0.1% fee on each tip goes to
the xchtip.app fee address; the recipient receives the remainder. The fee is shown clearly on the
amount screen BEFORE the send/cancel buttons — not hidden fine print, and no page claims the tip
itself is free (only that using xchtip.app requires no signup/account).
The embed asset and its wasm
are served with permissive CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) so it loads from any page on any
domain, and the site imposes no frame/embedding restrictions.

- Builder: https://xchtip.app/
- Tip page (per recipient): https://xchtip.app/jar/<recipient>
- Embed preview (iframe target): https://xchtip.app/embed-preview
- Embed script: https://xchtip.app/embed/xch-tip.js
- Sitemap: https://xchtip.app/sitemap.xml
